Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

10. Additional amount of Retirement Gratuity.Additional amount of retirement gratuity due to the pensioner as authorized by the authority issuing the PPO will be credited by the Bank / P.O. to the account of the pensioner under advice to him.
